companies.name: バブコック・アンド・ウィルコックス

relations.text: B&Wの借入契約の幹事行。現金・資金管理もAxos Bankに置くよう求められている
relations.text_en: Administrative agent on B&W's credit agreement, which also requires B&W to keep its cash management at Axos Bank

source.label: Babcock & Wilcox 10-K付属の契約(2025年度)
source.label_en: Babcock & Wilcox credit amendment filed with its 10-K (FY2025)
source.quote: Maintain all primary cash management and treasury business with Axos Bank.

companies.name: B.ライリー・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: B. Rileyが10-K/Aで、B&Wの借入契約の幹事行Axos Bankに保証を差し入れたと記載
relations.text_en: B. Riley guaranteed B&W's credit agreement in favor of Axos Bank as administrative agent

source.label: B. Riley Financial 10-K/A(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 18, 2024, the Company entered into a guaranty (the "Axos Guaranty") in favor of (i) Axos Bank, in its capacity as administrative agent (the "Administrative Agent")

companies.name: ギャンブリング・ドットコム・グループ

relations.text: Gambling.comが20-Fで、借入枠の貸し手の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Gambling.com lists Axos Bank among the lenders on its credit facility

source.label: Gambling.com Group 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Wells Fargo, Axos Bank, 67 First-Citizens Bank and Trust Company, Citibank, N.A., Texas Capital Bank, and Comerica Bank are lenders under the Wells Fargo Credit Facility.

companies.name: プライオリティ・テクノロジー

relations.text: Priority Technologyが10-Kで、銀行機能を借りる提携銀行の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Priority Technology names Axos Bank among its partner banks

source.label: Priority Technology 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We offer banking and money transmission services to our customers through our partner banks including Wells Fargo and Axos Bank.

companies.name: Aマーク・プレシャス・メタルズ

relations.text: A-Markが10-Kで、借入契約の共同幹事の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: A-Mark lists Axos Bank among the joint lead arrangers of its credit agreement

source.label: A-Mark Precious Metals 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: CIBC Bank USA, as agent and joint lead arranger, Coöperatieve Rabobank U.A., Axos Bank, Brown Brothers Harriman, California Bank & Trust and First Foundation Bank as joint lead arrangers
